people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Segub
people.line: Son of Hezron; father of Jair

translations.web: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
translations.bsb: Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
translations.kjv: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
translations.asv: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
